findings.title: No content-side secret policy: a secret-shaped plain string reaches the journal and a metric label unguarded; secrecy is enforced only by object identity (Tamoz::Secret)
findings.recommendation: Add one shape-level refusal in ContentPolicy#canonicalize_string (the single point every captured string passes through), so a credential-shaped string is refused or digest-replaced exactly as Tamoz::Secret is at guard_value!. Apply the same predicate in DropLedger#validate! and Metrics#validate_label_value!, which are already the two enforcement points. No new scanner class. If the owner instead keeps reliance on producer-wrapped Tamoz::Secret, promote the two observe-doctor literals into a property test and remove the 'above every policy decision' sentence from design/observability.md.

findings.title: Metrics.from_documents silently discards every signal it cannot project and reports :recorded, contradicting the design doc's 'Never lossy'
findings.recommendation: Count an unmatched document name as a violation in add_document (metrics.rb:68-75 already has @violations and count_violation), so the loss is visible in tamoz observe metrics --format json; and correct design/observability.md:58 to say the reconstruction is complete for projected signals and counted otherwise.

findings.title: DropLedger#drops_hash destructures an already-joined String key as a 3-tuple and re-joins it, emitting a malformed 'name:reason:lane::' drop identifier in every record
findings.recommendation: One-line fix at the ledger: store the tuple in count_drop (@drops[[name, reason, lane]] += 1) so drops_hash's destructuring is correct as written, or return @drops.to_h directly since the key is already a String. Add a key-shape assertion to the existing saturation test.

findings.title: Metric label cardinality is bounded by a series cap rather than by value validation: the low_cardinality check is a charset rule, so unvalidated label values consume and then block the series budget
findings.recommendation: Declare the already-closed label sets (outcome, kind, reason_class, status, direction) as :enum in catalog.rb and reject out-of-set values in validate_label_value!. Leave model/tool/profile as-is and accept the series cap; an allowlist for model names would be speculative machinery.

findings.title: The reserved-lane fallback performs a full disk write (and possible File.rename rotation) while holding the journal mutex that the drain thread needs, so a saturated reserved lane can stall the whole drain
findings.recommendation: Decide the lane under the lock and perform write_reserved_now after synchronize returns (recorder_journal.rb:81-84), preserving never-drop while removing disk I/O from the critical section. If the current shape is kept, state the accepted bound in the Recorder contract and let the outstanding non-interference proof measure it. Do not add a second writer thread.

findings.title: Trace produces a flat span list and can never build a parent chain (nothing writes parent_span_id/span_anchor), and divergence is a hardcoded empty array, while the design doc claims an 'authoritative span tree' and a counted divergence signal
findings.recommendation: No code change until the read-only telemetry adapter exists. Align design/observability.md:58-60 with the code and with limitations.md: state that the current projection is a flat ordered span list whose parentage is producer-supplied and not yet emitted, and mark tamoz.telemetry.divergence as declared-but-not-computed.

findings.title: The 'Observability remains partial' section of documentation/limitations.md (invariants 59-61, ADR-044-047) verified claim by claim against code; no contradicted claim found in that section
findings.recommendation: None. Verified design fact: the closed catalog, deterministic correlation, bounded journal, content policy, derived metrics, model cost basis and counted bulk drops are all implemented as stated, and the listed gaps (SQLite telemetry adapter, durable model-usage persistence, journal-only tamoz trace, outstanding four-way non-interference proof / full secret property test / export sampling / divergence accounting) are all confirmed absent. The two doc claims contradicted by code live in design/observability.md:47 and :58, recorded under F15-SEC-01, F15-OBS-01 and F15-OBS-02.
